Rohtu wants you to help find the [[Corsair]]s that killed his mother and take revenge against them.

==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
* Meet [[Rohtu]] in [[Lahtenda Bog]].
* Help Rohtu track down and kill the corsairs who killed his mother.
* See Rohtu for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 125 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Exit Blacktide Den into Lahtenda Bog and speak to Rohtu to have him follow you and head south until you find the Corsairs. Defeat them and Rohtu will run to the corpse of his mother and grieve. When he's done, speak to him to collect your reward.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Rohtu'''
:''"Sunspear!  My heart cries out for justice!  I must avenge my mother's death.  She was old and crazy, but she was my mother.  She did not deserve such a cruel end to her wretched life.  These '''corsairs''' must not get away with this...this murder!  Please, help me.  I told you I am not a warrior.  I could use a strong arm by my side.  I will do this by myself if I must.  But if you would help me in my hour of grief, it would mean a great deal to me...and my mother."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = It would be my honor to serve. You and your mother deserve justice.
|decline = I'm sorry, I wasn't listening. What did you say?
|ask = Meet me in '''Lahtenda Bog''' and help me hunt down the evil '''corsairs''' who killed my mother. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Rohtu'''
:''"Let's get moving!  I don't want those vermin to get away."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Rohtu'''
:''"I suppose there's no real way to be sure these were the corsairs who killed my mother, but my heart is still gladdened by their deaths.  The world is a better place without them in it any longer."''
